real: For first screen render, cache all of them. But, I wonder if searchPosts are just looking up specific actor. not search itself. See ../hackerspub
prev_agent: Current wiring (`SearchViewModel.search()`): | Mode | Call | Notes | |---|---|---| | People | `searchActorsByHandle(query.removePrefix("@"), limit = 30)` | strips leading `@` | | Posts | `searchPosts(query)` | raw query | | Tags | `searchPosts("#$query")` | prepends `#` if missing — reuses the post endpoint | | All | actors (limit 5) + posts, same normalizations | rendered as two sections | Every mode also fires `searchObject(query)` first to resolve a URL/handle into `resolvedObjectUrl` — but nothing in `SearchScreen` consumes that field or navigates on it, so that branch is currently dead work. Worth either wiring it up (navigate to profile/post when resolved) or removing the call.
